       measureAccPct * CASE 
           WHEN calibrStat = 'Valid' THEN 1.0

           WHEN calibrStat = 'Due' THEN 0.7
           WHEN calibrStat = 'Expired' THEN 0.3

ORDER BY ser DESC;
